notes.title: Small Update - 28/03/2025
notes.content:
Another tiny update I threw together for reasons unknown...


Adjusted character normals to be slightly more natural.
Fixed a buncha weird text issues.
Some other stuff I can't remember because I did it four months ago.

The end. Spider Land is out soon by the way. Stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Small Update - 08/11/2024
notes.content:
Here's an update for all you Rodeoheads out there.


Adjusted text formatting for internal thoughts. Now in italics...
Fixed some funky disappearing terrain. 
Fixed some decals being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
Fixed a buncha spelling mistakes.


That's all. It's full steam ahead on Spider Land now. Wishlist if you're chill like that.
